description: What a window COMPUTES over GROUPED rows, when its key or its argument is a RAW AGGREGATE the SELECT list never projects. The window stage runs after grouping, so those rows no longer carry what the aggregate needs - SUM(b) has to be computed over the group each output row came from. Frostlake used to answer input order for a ranking whose key was such an aggregate (the key was the same for every row), all-ties for RANK, and NULL for an aggregate argument. The three groups are deliberately ordered so the sums 30, 5 and 101 do NOT follow the group keys 1, 2 and 3: any ranking that merely echoes input order is visibly wrong. A window that is the ONLY select item ranks every row - its output rows are identical in value, one column carrying the rank, which used to collapse them into a single map entry and hand all three the same number. HAVING narrows the groups first and the ranking runs over what survives. Converted 1:1 from query/GroupedWindowValueTest (now retired); the Java read the last column of every row into a comma-joined string, which the converted tests state as ordered row sets carrying the group key beside the window value.

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b) DESC) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT a, SUM(SUM(b)) OVER () w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, MAX(SUM(b)) OVER () w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, MIN(SUM(b)) OVER () w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, SUM(SUM(b)) OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT a, LAG(SUM(b)) OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, LEAD(SUM(b)) OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, FIRST_VALUE(SUM(b)) OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, LAST_VALUE(SUM(b)) OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY 1
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY 1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a HAVING SUM(b) > 5 ORDER BY a
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gw (a INT, b INT)
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, COUNT(*) OVER () w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY SUM(b)) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, SUM(b) w FROM gw GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
